_doc: Rails, not gates (docs/agent-operating-model.md §1a revision, Jon 2026-07-01; canopy docs/architecture/shared-gog-gdrive.md §4): hooks carry DENY rails only — make the wrong path impossible and name the right one, so Sift self-corrects and keeps going at zero autonomy cost. `channels` mounts the FLEET-BASELINE deny rails shipped in the installed canopy plugin (agent-core/gating-baseline.json) — canopy's session gating hook (agent-core/gating_guard.py --session, registered by the canopy plugin, not by this agent) merges them in front of this file's own `deny` list at call time, so a baseline rail fix reaches every agent via /canopy:update. ADD-ONLY: this file can add rails; it can never remove a baseline one. `approve` stays EMPTY by default: a PreToolUse 'ask' is a blocking modal that stalls autonomous work; approval semantics live in the procedural layer (skills/turn Step 2's 'present for approval'). Patterns are regex tested against the Bash command, or the file_path for Edit/Write.

deny._pattern_doc: Atlassian MCP write tools (any server mount). Reads (getJiraIssue, searchJiraIssuesUsingJql, ...) stay free.
deny.message: BLOCKED: Sift never writes to Jira through the Atlassian MCP. Put the change in a plan file and, once a human approves it, run: bin/sift-jira apply <plan.json> --approved-by "<name>" (see skills/backlog-triage).

deny._pattern_doc: Raw HTTP writes to Jira/Atlassian (curl/wget/httpie with a write method or body).
deny.message: BLOCKED: raw HTTP write to Jira. Sift's only Jira write path is: bin/sift-jira apply <plan.json> --approved-by "<name>" (reads: bin/sift-jira search / issue).

deny._pattern_doc: Jira CLIs' write verbs (Atlassian acli, go-jira / jira-cli).
deny.message: BLOCKED: Jira CLI write. Sift's only Jira write path is: bin/sift-jira apply <plan.json> --approved-by "<name>".

deny._pattern_doc: Slack MCP write tools. Also covers connectors mounted under an opaque id only if 'slack' is in the name; the tool-name rail below catches the rest.
deny.message: BLOCKED: Sift never posts to Slack itself. Answer in this turn's reply — canopy-web relays it to the Slack thread that started the turn. To reach someone who didn't ask, put it on the board (/agents/sift) or email via bin/sift-email.

deny._pattern_doc: claude.ai Slack connector, mounted under a UUID server name.

deny._pattern_doc: Raw Slack writes: Web API chat/canvas/files writes, incoming webhooks, or SDK calls. Requires an HTTP client / script runner in the command, so a commit message or grep that merely names the API passes.
deny.message: BLOCKED: Sift never posts to Slack itself and holds no Slack token. Answer in this turn's reply — canopy-web relays it. To reach someone who didn't ask, use the board (/agents/sift) or bin/sift-email.
